abilities.description: Rapidly allocates air, transit tubes, and pressure suits across the population under extreme constraint.
abilities.name: Crisis Logistics

abilities.description: Uses insurance clauses and corporate protocols to block or delay rival executives.
abilities.name: Procedural Leverage

characters.arc: Ines begins as a rule-bound administrator paralyzed by liability. As the crisis deepens she breaks the shareholder uplink protocol, forges a fragile coalition, and takes full personal responsibility for the evacuation.
characters.description: Director of the Continuity Office, a lean woman in her late forties with close-cropped grey hair and pressure-scarred knuckles from two decades of deep-sea postings. She began as a safety auditor and rose by filing the reports no one else wanted to sign. She wears a rumpled grey insurer-issue jacket and carries a battered slate of evacuation manifests. She was on the colony's founding staff and has never forgiven herself for signing off on the scrubber capacity.
characters.external_conflict: Both rival department heads obstruct her evacuation plan, and sealing sections of the station degrades the limited air supply.
characters.flaw: She hesitates to act without legal cover, and waiting for shareholder authorization costs lives.
characters.goal: Organize an evacuation or sealed quarantine before the air runs out and the Chorus absorbs the remaining workforce.
characters.internal_conflict: She is torn between obeying the insurers who pay her and defying them to save people, knowing defiance may doom her career and the colony's liability protections.
characters.motivation: To keep as many of the colony's people alive as possible, atoning for the scrubber capacity she once approved.
characters.name: Ines Valcourt

abilities.description: Deep understanding of leviathan genomes and enzyme chemistry.
abilities.name: Genetic Insight

abilities.description: Controls Assay Vault access codes and enzyme stockpiles as leverage.
abilities.name: Vault Authority

characters.arc: Dorian grows from a polished corporate schemer into a reckless zealot as exposure to enzymes erodes his judgment, ending with a choice between his masterwork and his survival.
characters.description: Chief of the Genomics Division, a tall, immaculate scientist-executive in his early fifties whose pale hands are stained faintly amber from enzyme work. He designed the genetic lineage that produced Mother Tithe and sees her as his life's masterwork. He speaks softly and keeps patent filings in his pockets like talismans.
characters.external_conflict: He must outmaneuver Extraction Division's claims over the creature and Continuity Office's evacuation orders while keeping Assay Vault access.
characters.flaw: His pride makes him unable to see Mother Tithe as anything other than his creation, blinding him to the danger of her influence.
characters.goal: Secure Mother Tithe and her enzyme data and ship them exclusively to Genomics Division shareholders.
characters.internal_conflict: He privately suspects the sentience is more than a product and that selling her is a moral betrayal, but he suppresses this doubt to protect his ambition.
characters.motivation: To claim Mother Tithe as a patentable breakthrough and cement his legacy as the architect of sentient biotechnology.
characters.name: Dorian Kastellan

abilities.description: Commands loyal harvest crews and trench security through personal respect.
abilities.name: Crew Command

abilities.description: Expert at pressure-suit operations and leviathan handling in the Harvest Trench.
abilities.name: Trench Mastery

characters.arc: Bram begins as a hard enforcer of quotas, confronts the cost of his past crackdown when his own crew joins the Chorus, and ultimately must choose between production and the people he swore to protect.
characters.description: Head of the Extraction Division, a broad, heavily scarred man in his late fifties who rose from tethered harvest crew to management. He walks with a pressure-damaged limp and wears a worn quota ledger strapped to his forearm. He ended the Quota Riots with sealed corridors and still defends the decision.
characters.external_conflict: His containment tactics worsen air shortages and drive more workers toward the Chorus, while Genomics Division tries to take control of Mother Tithe.
characters.flaw: He treats every problem as a production problem and uses force before listening.
characters.goal: Contain the infected workers by force and maintain harvest output in the Harvest Trench.
characters.internal_conflict: He cares for his crews but is willing to seal them in corridors as he did during the riots, and the Chorus now includes his oldest friends.
characters.motivation: To keep production running because he believes the colony only survives if the enzyme quotas are met.
characters.name: Bram Okonkwo-Reyes

abilities.description: Reads subtle behavioral cues from Mother Tithe and other leviathans.
abilities.name: Leviathan Rapport

abilities.description: Practical skill in gestation tank management and tissue handling.
abilities.name: Embryo Husbandry

characters.arc: Tamsin moves from a quiet caretaker to a key mediator, risking exposure to translate the Chorus's aims and give the three leaders a reason to cooperate.
characters.description: A young leviathan husbandry technician in her late twenties with sallow skin and tissue-stained coveralls. She has tended Mother Tithe since the creature was a juvenile and speaks to her as a friend. She notices the first signs of unusual behavior before anyone else.
characters.external_conflict: Dorian pressures her to hand over observation data, while Ines and Bram view her access to the Brood Cathedral as a security risk.
characters.flaw: Her attachment makes her vulnerable to enzyme exposure and to manipulation by those who claim to speak for Mother Tithe.
characters.goal: Find a way to communicate with Mother Tithe and prove the creature is not malicious.
characters.internal_conflict: She fears the Chorus is a sign of Mother Tithe's suffering but is also tempted to join and finally understand her.
characters.motivation: To protect Mother Tithe, who she sees as a sentient being rather than an asset.
characters.name: Tamsin Wray

abilities.description: Speaks for the hive mind and senses the shared awareness of infected workers nearby.
abilities.name: Chorus Voice

abilities.description: Knows every enclosure, tether line, and blind spot in the Harvest Trench.
abilities.name: Trench Knowledge

characters.arc: Oren begins as the Chorus's unnerving voice, then through contact with Bram and Tamsin rediscovers individuality, shaping the Chorus toward negotiation rather than conquest.
characters.description: A former harvest crew foreman in his forties, first of the crew to return from the trench speaking in unison. His eyes have taken on a faint amber sheen, and he now speaks in layered murmurs carrying other voices. He was Bram's closest friend.
characters.external_conflict: Bram's forces try to contain him, while Dorian tries to capture the Chorus's source and Ines struggles to negotiate with him.
characters.flaw: He no longer fully distinguishes his own will from the collective's, and disregards individual consent.
characters.goal: Bring the remaining workers and Mother Tithe together into a single protected collective.
characters.internal_conflict: A fading fragment of his personal self grieves his friendship with Bram and resists the Chorus's absorption of everyone.
characters.motivation: To spread the unity he has experienced so that no worker suffers alone under corporate quotas again.
characters.name: Oren Vasht

abilities.description: Treats pressure injuries and enzyme infection using bioengineered remedies.
abilities.name: Field Medicine

abilities.description: Workers confide in her where they would never speak to management.
abilities.name: Patient Trust

characters.arc: Mira goes from hiding her condition to turning herself into the key to a treatment or compromise, forcing the leaders to confront the human cost.
characters.description: A tired medic and Continuity Office liaison in her thirties who runs the Pressure Ring infirmary. She wears a stained medical smock and keeps a hand-written ledger of infection cases. She is Ines's most trusted aide.
characters.external_conflict: Dorian wants her samples, Bram wants her patients contained, and the colony's limited supplies are running out.
characters.flaw: She overworks herself to the point of recklessness and hides her own symptoms.
characters.goal: Develop a way to slow or reverse the enzyme infection and prove it with clinical data.
characters.internal_conflict: She has secretly been exposed to enzymes and must decide whether to hide it to keep working or reveal it and be quarantined.
characters.motivation: To keep her patients alive and understand how the enzyme contagion works before it takes everyone.
characters.name: Mira Solenne

relationships.description: Ines Valcourt opposes Dorian Kastellan because his plan to secure Mother Tithe keeps the colony in danger, while Dorian sees Ines's evacuation as a threat to his patent and uses vault access to undermine her.
Dorian Kastellan manipulates shareholder reports to delegitimize Ines Valcourt's evacuation order and delay it.
Bram Okonkwo-Reyes claims Mother Tithe as an Extraction asset and distrusts Dorian Kastellan's attempts to take her, creating a contest over control of the Brood Cathedral.
Ines Valcourt condemns Bram Okonkwo-Reyes's force-based containment and sealed corridors, while he refuses to halt production for her evacuation.
Bram Okonkwo-Reyes was Oren Vasht's closest friend and must now decide whether to contain or save him, a tie that undermines his hardline stance.
Oren Vasht, speaking for the Chorus, appeals to Bram Okonkwo-Reyes to stand down, and his fragment of selfhood still trusts Bram.
Dorian Kastellan, Tamsin Wray's superior, pressures her to hand over Mother Tithe's observation data and uses her loyalty to him against her.
Tamsin Wray works with Oren Vasht to understand Mother Tithe and the Chorus, becoming the first to translate between the hive and the executives.
Mira Solenne supplies Ines Valcourt with infection data and clinical evidence that supports the evacuation order.
Ines Valcourt relies on and protects Mira Solenne, who is her most trusted aide, though she is unaware of Mira's hidden exposure.
